long_biography.plain_text:
At the Copa del Rey in 2015, footwear entrepreneur Vicente García Torres sailed at the helm alongside professional sailors, his children and friends. The racing programme was organised by ocean-racing veteran Jan Santana, with specialists handling navigation, tactics and sail trimming. His sustained sporting commitment brought him honorary membership of the Real Club de Regatas de Alicante.

His business background lay in Garvalín, the children’s footwear company established by his family. He moved beyond that enterprise when an initial order from Amancio Ortega’s group developed into a lasting partnership. The business brought together shoe design and clothing retail within the same shops. Tempe’s first collection for Zara arrived in 1990 in the children’s department.
